credits_text: Written by Mark Balland and Casey Ringler. Directed by Graham Kelly Greene.
other_text: "Attack of the Bat Monsters" is a tight little tale that grabs you by the throat and holds you until the final frame. "Attack of the Bat Monsters" features creatures who have teeth for weapons, claws for hands and muscles for defense.
